# 1. QUICKSORT
# =============================================================================

def quicksort(arr: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    """
    Sort a list of integers in-place using the Quicksort algorithm.

    Strategy:
        1. Pick a pivot element (here: the last element in the sub-array).
        2. Partition the array so that elements < pivot are on the left,
           elements > pivot are on the right, and the pivot is in its
           final sorted position.
        3. Recursively apply the same process to the left and right sub-arrays.

    Time Complexity:
        - Average case: O(n log n)
        - Worst case:   O(n²)  (occurs when the array is already sorted
                                and we always pick the last element as pivot)
    Space Complexity:
        - O(log n) auxiliary space for the recursion stack (average case).

    Args:
        arr: The list of integers to sort (modified in place).

    Returns:
        The same list, now sorted in ascending order.
